## "Stop guessing, start growing. Insightify that reveal what customers love and what needs fixing"

Insightify is an AI review analytics app that helps Shopify merchants understand customer sentiment without manually reading every review. Using AI-powered sentiment analysis, Insightify scans your product reviews and turns them into clear business insights, growth signals, and risk alerts so you always know what customers love, what's frustrating them, and what to fix next. Whether you're tracking customer satisfaction, monitoring product quality, or looking for data-driven growth opportunities

- Turn raw customer reviews into clear, actionable insights.

- Track positive, neutral, and negative sentiments trends over time.

- Automatically flag recurring product,delivery, and customer experience problems.

- Spot opportunities and risks before they impact sales.

- Get an at-a-glance performance score based on customer feedback.
